metadata.event_count_withholding_reason: Complementary suppression prevents reconstruction of rare focal event counts.
metadata.event_definition: first NEW phecode in the body system with the whole cohort at risk (`anynew`) -- a diagnostic-accrual hazard, not first-ever disease onset

inference.ci_method: Tie-aware Greenwood / infinitesimal-jackknife variance; pointwise log-log transform
inference.logrank_method: Two-sided cause-specific log-rank; competing death censored; administratively censored at 3 years; nominal p-values
inference.comparison: Each OSA phenotype versus pooled other seven OSA; No OSA versus all eight OSA pooled

cohort.no_osa_definition: AHI < 5 in the existing IncWAS follow-up spine
cohort.osa_definition: Existing three-domain phenotype cohort restricted to AHI >= 5; original octant assignments and cut points retained
cohort.model_note: Adjusted Cox estimates retain the original 25,380-person phenotype cohort. Curves exclude 154 people with AHI < 5 and therefore use a different cohort.
